name: appdyno
description: Let an AI agent drive, test and measure your mobile app: iOS and Android, on simulators, emulators and real phones.
long_description:
An agent reads the screen as elements, taps, types and swipes. It sends a push, opens a deep link, and measures how the app starts, scrolls and holds its memory. Every action answers with the screen once it has settled, so the agent sees what it did in the same call. You can watch and touch the same device in a live window. It all runs on your Mac, with no cloud and no telemetry.

What you need: a Mac, and Node 22 or newer. For an iOS simulator or an iPhone: Xcode, and iOS 17 or newer. For an Android emulator or phone: `adb`, from Android Studio or Google's platform tools, and Android 8.0 (API 26) or newer.

allow_devices.title: Devices it may drive
allow_devices.description: Only devices whose serial, UDID or name matches this JavaScript regular expression: ^emulator-5554$ for one emulator, ^emulator- for every emulator. Empty: every device connected to this Mac.

allow_apps.title: Apps it may touch
allow_apps.description: Only these apps, by id, with a comma between them: com.example.shop, com.example.shop.dev. A touch, a key or typing that would land in another app, and a link that would open one, is refused. Empty: every app.

allow_urls.title: Links it may open
allow_urls.description: Only links that match this JavaScript regular expression, anchored: ^https://staging\.example\.com/ where the / ends the host. Empty: web links and the links the selected app takes; any other asks you first.

allow_write.title: Folders it may write in
allow_write.description: A folder a screenshot, a video or a report may be saved in when the path is named in a request, as ~/Desktop/appdyno; several with a colon between them. Empty: only appdyno's own folder under ~/Library/Caches/appdyno.

toolsets.title: Groups of tools to list
toolsets.description: Only these groups of tools, with a comma between them: core, device, apps, evidence, network, perf. core alone drives and reads the screen; fewer groups make a shorter list for the model to read in every chat. Empty: every tool.
